title: 第13章 陛下震怒第14章 下令追查幕后下毒之人
slug: 开局六连抽创建万古帝朝
content_zh:
蓦然之间，
只听得一阵轻微的风声掠过，
一道黑影便如同鬼魅一般悄然浮现。
此人从头到脚都被一件宽大的黑袍所笼罩，那黑袍仿佛与周围无尽的黑暗浑然一体，让人难以分辨其身形轮廓。
更为引人注目的是，黑袍之上竟然绣着一个神秘而诡异的“密”字，那字纹丝不动地镶嵌于布料之中，散发着令人心悸的气息。
这道黑影宛如幽灵一般，无声无息地出现在了玉案之前。
只见他动作轻柔得如同微风拂过一般，将一个小小的纸条轻轻地放置在了龙椅旁边那位身着紫色宦官服饰之人手中。
这位老太监头发已然花白如银，岁月的痕迹深深地刻在他的面庞之上。
此刻，他正低垂着头颅，身体微倾着，脸上满是诚惶诚恐之色。
老太监双手接过纸条之后，不敢有丝毫耽搁，立刻迈着细碎而谨慎的步子走到自家主子身旁，恭恭敬敬地将纸条呈上。
而后，他又像是心领神会一般，迅速从主子手中接过那份奏折，再小心翼翼地将其放置到一旁的玉案之上。
整个过程一气呵成，没有发出半点声响。
坐在龙椅之上的皇帝萧玉龙，先是漫不经心地瞥了一眼那个小纸条。
随后，他才缓缓伸出手去，慢慢地将纸条拿了起来。
缓缓展开那张小纸条，看起了纸条上的文字，
起初，他的表情还显得颇为平静，
但随着阅读的不断深入，他的眉头渐渐紧锁起来，原本平和的面容也逐渐被一层阴霾所覆盖。
到最后，他的脸色更是变得愈发阴沉，
好似头顶上方突然聚拢了一大片厚重的乌云，随时都会降下倾盆暴雨来。
直至将整个内容阅览完毕之后，端坐在龙椅之上的皇帝萧玉龙，其原本就冰冷如霜的双眸此刻更是散发出令人不寒而栗的肃杀之气。

他那犹如利剑一般锐利的眼神，直直地刺向了玉案前方那个浑身上下都被一袭黑袍紧紧包裹着的身影。
只见此人的衣服上还绣有一个极为特殊的“密”字，
显然是来自于大萧皇朝最神秘莫测的情报机构密谍司。
皇帝萧玉龙面色阴沉如水，声音低沉而又严厉地质问道：
“你们密谍司究竟是在什么时候才知晓凡王中毒这件事情的？”
感受着皇帝那仿佛能够穿透灵魂的如同寒冰一般刺骨的目光，那位全身被黑袍所笼罩、衣服上绣着特殊“密”字的秘谍卫只觉得自己瞬间坠入了万丈冰窖之中，通体冰凉，寒意彻骨。
豆大的汗珠不受控制地从额头滑落，浸湿了他的衣衫。
他的嘴唇微微颤抖着，想要开口说话却发现喉咙好似被什么东西堵住了一般，
只能结结巴巴地回应道：“回……回陛下，小的们……是从今日清晨都城内开始流传的那些民谣，还有凡王府门口高高悬挂起的白色绫布和白色招魂幡那里得知此事的。”
听到这样的答复，
皇帝萧玉龙的脸色变得愈发难看，他冷哼一声说道：
“哼！如此重要之事，你们竟然等到现在才有所察觉。真是一群饭桶！
立刻给朕滚下去，
把这里发生的一切如实告知你们的统领。
倘若日后你们密谍司还是这般毫无长进，朕绝对不会心慈手软，
定会毫不犹豫地给密谍司换上一个新的统领！”
说罢，皇帝稍稍停顿了一下，
紧接着再次下达命令道：
content_en:
Suddenly,
Only a slight breeze was heard passing by,
A black shadow appeared quietly like a ghost.
This person was covered from head to toe by a wide black robe. The black robe seemed to be integrated with the endless darkness around him, making it difficult to distinguish the outline of his figure.
What is even more eye-catching is that there is a mysterious and strange word "secret" embroidered on the black robe. The word is embedded in the fabric motionlessly, exuding a heart-stopping aura.
This black shadow was like a ghost, appearing silently in front of the jade case.
His movements were as gentle as the breeze, and he gently placed a small piece of paper in the hands of the man wearing purple eunuch clothes next to the dragon chair.
The old eunuch's hair was as white as silver, and the traces of time were deeply etched on his face.
At this moment, he was lowering his head, leaning slightly, with a look of fear on his face.
After taking the note with both hands, the old eunuch did not dare to delay at all. He immediately walked to his master with thin and cautious steps and presented the note respectfully.
Then, as if he understood it by heart, he quickly took the memorial from his master and carefully placed it on the jade table aside.
The whole process was completed in one go without making any noise.
Emperor Xiao Yulong, who was sitting on the dragon chair, glanced at the small note casually.
Then, he slowly reached out his hand and slowly picked up the note.
Slowly unfolding the small piece of paper and reading the words on the paper,
At first, his expression seemed quite calm.
But as he continued to read, his brows gradually furrowed, and his originally peaceful face was gradually covered by a layer of gloom.
In the end, his face became even more gloomy,
It seemed as if a large thick dark cloud suddenly gathered above the head, and a downpour would fall at any time.
After reading the entire content, Emperor Xiao Yulong, who was sitting on the dragon chair, his eyes that were already as cold as frost now exuded a chilling aura.
His sharp eyes, as sharp as a sword, pierced the figure in front of the jade table, who was tightly wrapped in a black robe.
I saw that this person's clothes also had a very special word "secret" embroidered on them.
Apparently it came from the Secret Service, the most mysterious intelligence agency in the Great Xiao Dynasty.
Emperor Xiao Yulong's face was as gloomy as water, and his voice was low and stern as he asked:
"When did your Secret Service know about King Fan's poisoning?"
Feeling the emperor's piercing ice-like gaze that seemed to be able to penetrate the soul, the secret spy guard, whose whole body was shrouded in black robes and with the special word "secret" embroidered on his clothes, felt that he had instantly fallen into an ice cellar of ten thousand feet, and his whole body was cold and chilled to the bone.
Beads of sweat fell uncontrollably from his forehead, soaking his clothes.
His lips trembled slightly, and he wanted to speak but found that his throat seemed to be blocked by something.
He could only stammer in reply: "Back...back to Your Majesty, young ladies...we learned about this from the folk songs that began to circulate in the capital early this morning, as well as the white silk cloth and white soul-calling flags hung high at the entrance of Prince Fan's Mansion."
Hearing such a reply,
Emperor Xiao Yulong's face became more and more ugly, and he snorted coldly and said:
"Hmph! You didn't notice such an important thing until now. What a bunch of idiots!
Get out of here immediately,
Tell your commander the truth about what happened here.
If your Secret Service still shows no progress in the future, I will never be merciful.
He will definitely give the Secret Service a new leader without hesitation! "
After saying that, the emperor paused for a moment and said,
Then he issued the order again:
